observations.preconditions: The owner's installed Chrome extension exposed the existing manager session in the browser inventory.
observations.human_actions: Opened the existing manager tab and inspected the company settings page without changing fields or submitting data.
observations.expected: The manager session is controllable and the company page loads under the expected role.
observations.observed: The header identifies the session as Gerencia. The company page and its configuration form render. An existing QA record was visible and left unchanged.

observations.preconditions: Authenticated Recepción session in the existing Chrome tab.
observations.human_actions: Navigated directly to the company settings route and inspected the authorization response without submitting data.
observations.expected: Recepción cannot view or edit company configuration by default.
observations.observed: The application displays the explicit no-permission message and offers a return to the user's start page. No company details are exposed.

observations.preconditions: A pre-existing cash session is open in the shared hotel account; current hotel date selected in the daily view.
observations.human_actions: Inspected the cash overview, open-session list, and closure instructions. Did not register a movement, close, approve, or alter notes.
observations.expected: Verify the closure and successor-cash handoff without changing another run's open session.
observations.observed: A pre-existing session dated 25 July is still open. The page states that after closure Dueño or Codueña confirms custody and records separately the change left for the successor drawer. The close action is available but was not used because this is not a synthetic session from this run.
observations.cleanup_state: No changes; pre-existing open session preserved. Local integration verification remains available.

observations.preconditions: Dueño and Gerencia sessions available; owner MFA is already enabled.
observations.human_actions: Opened the security page as Dueño, then directly as Gerencia. Inspected status and access response without invoking MFA management actions.
observations.expected: An account without MFA can start enrollment; non-owner roles remain outside owner-only security settings.
observations.observed: Dueño sees MFA marked active and recovery-code/disable controls. Gerencia receives the expected no-permission response. Source includes a distinct activation/enrollment branch, but no available account has MFA disabled for visible enrollment verification.
observations.cleanup_state: Read-only; MFA configuration was not changed.

observations.preconditions: Authenticated Dueño session on the deployed main build.
observations.human_actions: Inspected current subscription state and plan options. Did not open checkout or change the plan.
observations.expected: The active account reports its real write status and does not invent plan pricing; trial-lock behavior can be checked only with a trial account.
observations.observed: The account shows Pro as active with writing enabled, near the listed room limit. Starter, Pro, and Ultra show price-to-be-defined copy, consistent with the owner's deferred pricing decision. Demo checkout actions were left untouched. Trialing-state behavior was not exercised on this active account.
observations.cleanup_state: Read-only; no plan or checkout changed.

observations.preconditions: Authenticated Dueño session in the existing Chrome tab.
observations.human_actions: Opened the hotel settings page and inspected currency, FX market, visibility, payment, and check-in defaults without editing or saving.
observations.expected: The owner can choose hotel currency, select Oficial or Blue, and choose visible quote markets without using other USD variants.
observations.observed: The currency selector lists ARS, USD, EUR, BRL, CLP, and UYU. The market selector lists Oficial or Blue for all currencies; Oficial is selected and visible, while Blue is hidden. The page displays DolarAPI quote data for USD and the other supported currencies with its estimated-Blue explanation. No preference was changed.

observations.preconditions: Manager company page observed read-only; application source checked at deployed SHA.
observations.human_actions: Inspected the visible surcharge control and the Company model, request schema, and nightly-charge service. No company data was changed.
observations.expected: Each company surcharge version can have an effective date; charges use the price applicable to each stay date while preserving earlier prices.
observations.observed: The UI exposes a single surcharge input with no effective-date control. Company stores one extra_person_nightly_surcharge value, and nightly charge generation reads that current value for selected dates. Historical effective rates cannot be represented.

observations.preconditions: Company booking remains unmodified; current backend and UI source checked at deployed SHA.
observations.human_actions: Inspected reservation fields, manual room-move service, room-move route permissions, company permission defaults, and company payment route. No mutation was attempted.
observations.expected: An upgrade can assign a larger physical room and record the extra-person charge while preserving the contracted double rate/category; company booking edits require company authorization, while reception may collect configured nightly extras.
observations.observed: Room movement can preserve total_amount with price_action=keep but overwrites the reservation's sole category_id with the destination category. The room-move route checks movement permissions without also requiring company:manage for company reservations. Company charges are created with company:manage; reception lacks that permission by default, while charge payment uses the separate reservation-charge permission.

observations.preconditions: Manager session in hotel 4; owner tariff calendar visibly showed prices for Doble Baño Compartido on 20-22 October 2026. Reservation modal was used without choosing a guest or submitting.
observations.human_actions: Selected Doble Baño Compartido, entered check-in 20/10/2026 and check-out 22/10/2026, observed the quote request and error, then closed the modal; inspected the quote and pricing resolution in the baseline source.
observations.expected: The quote uses the visible active prices for the selected category and dates, and the form remains usable.
observations.observed: GET /api/bookings/price-quote?category_id=5&check_in_date=2026-10-20&check_out_date=2026-10-22&occupancy=1 returned HTTP 400 with detail 'No active prices found for rate plan'. The UI says no rate is available and disables Crear although the owner tariff calendar shows prices. Baseline source inspection confirms that an inferred single rate plan is selected and its strict RatePlanPrice resolver shadows the legacy daily/seasonal rate resolver. No reservation was created.
observations.cleanup_state: Modal closed without submission; no records changed.

observations.preconditions: Dueño MFA activo; Owner abrió Configuración > Permisos.
observations.human_actions: La página presentó Confirmá que sos vos y pidió un código TOTP. La lectura del autenticador quedó interrumpida cuando la Mac se bloqueó; no se ingresó código ni se modificaron permisos.
observations.expected: Comprobar que la matriz administrativa y los controles de codueña están disponibles tras step-up.
observations.observed: La ruta requiere MFA adicional antes de cargar permisos. La sesión visual quedó bloqueada por el estado de la Mac, por lo que no se pudo continuar. No se observó ni almacenó ningún código.
observations.cleanup_state: Sin cambios; requiere desbloquear Mac para continuar.

observations.preconditions: Dueño completed the existing step-up flow; matrix is read-only and both integrated roles are shown.
observations.human_actions: Compared the visible Owner and Co-owner permission checkboxes in the role matrix. No permissions were changed.
observations.expected: Co-owner has the same administrative access to Users, Subscription, Security, Permissions, and owner-level reservation finance/rate tools, except the system-level property ownership transfer.
observations.observed: Co-owner matches Owner for users view/manage, subscription view/manage, security view, and permissions manage. Differences: Owner-only property transfer (expected); Owner-only reservation:manual_rate, reservation:manual_rate_policy_manage, reservation:paid_total_adjust, apikey:manage, and hotel_settings:security_manage. These five administrative differences conflict with the owner-confirmed same-admin-access requirement and need implementation review. No live settings were changed.
observations.cleanup_state: Read-only matrix comparison; no settings changed.
